name: Cassava bánh tằm
summary: Bánh tằm made from cassava flour, on the Người Lao Động account of Củ Chi cassava. Tuổi Trẻ names bánh tằm as an order at a stall open more than 30 years, and prints no street.
origin: Củ Chi. Người Lao Động, on 6 Mar 2017, says the root is ground to flour and made into bánh tằm. Tuổi Trẻ, on 5 May 2024, names bánh tằm among orders at a juice stall.
howToEat: Người Lao Động names the flour and does not describe a sauce or a topping.
Tuổi Trẻ names bánh tằm as something to order and does not describe it. No street was printed.
No price was printed. Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: No street was printed. Check on arrival
